descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S04b 「养老院：In Today 的住户落进对的格子，每行的单元和未完成任务数都对」 Nursing Home: the In Today residents fall into the right buckets, with the right unit and open-task count per row

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently（TFA-92598 How it works 1；TFA-92598 How it works 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given The S04a census (same seed)

When Open the Nursing Home dashboard from the bottom nav

Then Pending 2, In Progress 2, Complete 1, Total 5, counted on the In Today set only; the tiles add up. N1's row reads 'Cedar 101 · 2 tasks pending' and N3's 'Cedar 103 · 1 task pending'. The foreign resident is absent

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Ticket rule 1 applied to the In Today set (TFA-92598 AC 4): counts 5/2/2/1 and countsSumToTotal. This catches a Total taken from In Today while the buckets still count every resident. The row lines tie the stored unit and the open-task count to the row (prototype row shape, T2). …

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）
